messages.author: e2589719bf554cfe
messages.subject: Extra spacing for axis labels
parts:
I am experiencing difficulties creating extra spacing between axis
labels and tick labels in my plots. The code below is an example plot
whose x& y-axes need extra spacing, however, some on my plots [1] are
worse than this.

At this point, I am uncertain if my using tikzDevice package has
anything to do with this. I have come across past threads [2] whose
solutions haven't been helpful. How do I tell ggplot2 to explicitly
add extra spacing?


require(ggplot2)
require(reshape2)
require(grid)
require(scales)

dataset <- read.csv(text="Workload,GetRecord,ListIdentifiers,ListRecords,ListSets
100,0.01,0.01,0.48,0
200,0.01,0.02,0.98,0.01
400,0.01,0.06,2,0
800,0.02,0.17,4.12,0.01
1600,0.02,0.39,5.41,0.01
3200,0.05,0.77,5.94,0.02
6400,0.08,1.53,6.73,0.04
12800,0.15,3.09,8.37,0.07
25600,0.3,6.25,11.68,0.12
51200,0.59,13.38,18.9,0.24
102400,1.2,28.46,33.46,0.49
204800,2.45,61.86,66.95,0.99
409600,4.87,133.94,139.72,1.99
819200,10.72,548.08,586.45,11.61
1638400,608.11,1922.89,1937.09,609.18
"
)

experimentdataset <- melt(dataset, id.vars=c(1))

ggplot(data=experimentdataset,
aes(x=as.factor(Workload),
y=value,
group=variable)) +
geom_line(aes(linetype=variable)) +
geom_point(aes(shape=variable), fill="white") +
scale_shape_manual(values=c(1,4,13,23)) +
scale_linetype_manual(values=c("solid","dotdash","longdash","dotted"))
+
scale_x_discrete(labels=c("100","200","400","800","1.6k","3.2k","6.4k","12.8k","25.6k","51.2k","102.4k","204.8k","409.6k","819.2k","1638.4k"))
+
scale_y_log10(breaks = trans_breaks("log10", function(x)
10^x), labels = trans_format("log10", math_format(10^.x))) +
labs(x="Workload Size",y="log10(Time [ms])") +
theme(legend.title=element_blank(),
legend.position=c(0.15,0.78),
plot.margin=unit(c(0.2,0.15,0.30,0.05),"cm"), axis.text.x =
element_text(angle=90, vjust=0.5))


[1] https://groups.google.com/d/topic/ggplot2/3t6oWjVnL8Q/discussion
[2] see ggplot2-axis-label-spacing01.png in attachment


-- Phiri

messages.subject: Re: Extra spacing for axis labels
parts:
Hello there,

Mail got stuck in drafts folder... Thank you very much for this; it
really helped, along with an email I got from Dennis Murphy.
Incidentally, I was not aware that values for hjust and vjust are only
defined between 0 and 1 [1]

[1] http://stackoverflow.com/a/7267364/664424

>>>>> Dennis Murphy Wrote: <<<<<

Hi:

There are a couple of ways you could go:

1. Q & D method: Stick a trailing \n on the y-label and a leading \n
on the x-label. Downside: It may not scale properly if you change font
sizes, and it is a hack solution.
2. Use vjust to increase the spacing between ticks and labels. Likely
safer than option 1, but it probably requires some tinkering to get it
right.

Try it out and see which one you like better (if any).

Dennis

>>>>> <<<<<
Lighton Phiri
http://lightonphiri.org
